    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: A real <textarea> with a <label> tied to it – works with forms, autofill and screen readers
      - listitem: The hint, the error and the count are linked with aria-describedby; an error sets aria-invalid and is announced politely
      - listitem: The More room button reports its state with aria-pressed and points at the field with aria-controls; the shortcut is listed in aria-keyshortcuts
      - listitem: Without a label, a text placeholder becomes the field's accessible name – better still, pass aria-label
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: "No focus ring: the hairline edge firms up on hover and a little more on focus"
      - listitem: The field grows line by line as you type, without animation – it never lags behind the caret
      - listitem: More room glides the height open and closed; the corner icon swaps out of a short blur
      - listitem: An error nudges the field once and its message slides in where the hint was – nothing below moves
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything switches instantly
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Fills its container; it measures again when its width changes, because the text wraps differently
      - listitem: On touch screens it uses 16px text, so iOS doesn't zoom in on focus, and the corner button grows to 32px
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
